chapters.reason: Describes converting fixed-architecture Transformers to linearized, sub-quadratic attention via targeted fine-tuning and low-rank adapters (LoRA) — a hidden-state conversion approach.
Touches on linear-state recurrence concepts through linearized update rules and sub-quadratic attention, focusing on efficient computation with linear kernels.
Demonstrates applications and capabilities achieved with linearized LLMs (e.g., large-scale models, improved benchmarks).
